attr.name: interactCastingAnimation
attr.use: text, an animation name; when it is set, the interact state plays it during the cast

attr.name: corpseEffect
attr.use: text, an effect name kept with the corpse settings; the dead state reads it

attr.name: vipLevel
attr.use: whole number; above zero the item counts as a premium item of that level

attr.name: param3
attr.use: whole number, the third numeric argument kept with the item function

attr.name: requireQuest
attr.use: a quest id; a field object asks whether that quest is rewarded and shows a notice with the quest name when it is not

attr.name: setItemRestrainID
attr.use: whole number kept with the field; a getter of the field data returns it

attr.name: dropRank
attr.use: whole number kept with the field beside the map level; no reader of it was found in the client

attr.name: globalDropBoxID
attr.use: list of whole numbers kept with the field; no reader of it was found in the client

attr.name: achievementGrade
attr.use: whole number; when it is not zero the required achievement is checked at that grade

attr.name: startTime
attr.use: text; the client reads it and keeps nothing of it

attr.name: endTime
attr.use: text; the client reads it and keeps nothing of it

attr.name: karma
attr.use: whole number kept with the completion rewards; the reward calculation reads it

attr.name: mentoringSeason
attr.use: whole number kept with the mentoring mission settings

attr.name: targetHasBuffOverlapCount
attr.use: whole number kept with the sensor beside the buff id the target must have

attr.name: maxDistance
attr.use: decimal number kept with the magic control settings beside the move speed and the duration

attr.name: effectInvoke
attr.use: text, an effect name kept with the arrow beside its other effects

attr.name: hand
attr.use: whole number kept with the damage settings

attr.name: damagedVibrateRatio
attr.use: decimal number kept with the damage settings; when it is not given the ratio is one

attr.name: activeByIntervalTick
attr.use: whole number kept with the triggered skill

attr.name: chain
attr.use: whole number kept with the triggered skill; zero when it is not given

attr.name: chainDistance
attr.use: decimal number kept with the triggered skill; a built-in distance is used when it is not given
